text:
I’m passionate about building polished, reliable web experiences, and I’m a hard-working frontend developer with 7 years of experience delivering production applications in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS.

Your chat app project is a strong fit for my background. I’ve worked on frontend-heavy products that needed careful state handling, responsive layouts, and clean user experiences, and I’m comfortable collaborating on long-running engagements like your 20hr/week, 6-month build. I also understand the importance of getting the details right in a chat product: authentication flows, error handling, real-time UI behavior, and smooth desktop/mobile responsiveness.

One relevant project was a Streaming chat widget for Quillstack, where I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. The result was first token on screen in about 600 ms, supporting 30k chats a month. That work gave me practical experience with chat UX, streamed interactions, and the kind of frontend/backend coordination that matters in messaging products.

I also worked on a Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team edits themselves. Using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Sanity, and Vercel, I helped improve largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and contributed to organic traffic growth of 38% in 3 months. That project reinforced my approach to building responsive, maintainable interfaces with strong performance and clear user flows.

For your chat application, I’d focus on building a clean and scalable frontend in Next.js and Tailwind, with attention to authentication using access/refresh tokens, error states, and responsive behavior across desktop and mobile. I’m also comfortable working through UI patterns like scrolling user lists and conversation panels, and I’d be glad to help shape the experience around Twilio Conversation SDK integration.

If you’re looking for someone dependable who can contribute consistently over the next several months, I’d love to help.
